name: Barbell Bench Press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with feet flat on the floor
Grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder width
Unrack and lower the bar to mid-chest
Press the bar up until arms are fully extended
Keep your back slightly arched and shoulder blades retracted

name: Dumbbell Flyes
instructions: Lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells above chest
With a slight bend in elbows, lower arms out to the sides
Lower until you feel a stretch in your chest
Squeeze chest to bring dumbbells back together

name: Push-Ups
instructions: Start in a plank position with hands shoulder-width apart
Lower your body until chest nearly touches the floor
Keep your body in a straight line throughout
Push back up to the starting position

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
instructions: Set bench to 30-45 degree incline
Hold dumbbells at shoulder level
Press up until arms are extended
Lower slowly back to starting position

name: Cable Crossover
instructions: Stand between cable stations with pulleys set high
Grip handles and step forward slightly
With slight bend in elbows, bring hands together in front of chest
Squeeze chest at the bottom, then return slowly

name: Barbell Deadlift
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width apart, bar over mid-foot
Bend at hips and knees to grip the bar
Keep back flat, drive through heels to stand up
Lock out hips at the top
Lower the bar back down with control

name: Pull-Ups
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with overhand grip
Pull yourself up until chin is above the bar
Keep core tight and avoid swinging
Lower yourself slowly to full hang

name: Dumbbell Row
instructions: Place one knee and hand on a bench
Hold a dumbbell in the other hand, arm extended
Pull the dumbbell to your hip, squeezing your shoulder blade
Lower the weight with control

name: Lat Pulldown
instructions: Sit at a lat pulldown machine with thighs under the pads
Grip the bar wider than shoulder width
Pull the bar down to your upper chest
Squeeze your lats, then slowly return

name: Seated Cable Row
instructions: Sit at a cable row station with feet on the platform
Grab the handle with both hands
Pull the handle to your lower chest, squeezing shoulder blades
Return slowly to the starting position

name: Overhead Press
instructions: Stand with bar at shoulder height in a rack
Grip bar just outside shoulder width
Press the bar overhead until arms are locked out
Lower the bar back to shoulder height with control

name: Lateral Raises
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides
Raise arms out to the sides until parallel with the floor
Keep a slight bend in the elbows
Lower slowly back down

name: Face Pulls
instructions: Set cable to upper position with rope attachment
Pull the rope toward your face, separating hands
Squeeze shoulder blades together at the end
Return slowly to starting position

name: Arnold Press
instructions: Sit holding dumbbells at chest height, palms facing you
Press up while rotating palms to face forward
Fully extend arms overhead
Reverse the motion back to start

name: Barbell Curl
instructions: Stand holding a barbell with underhand grip
Keep elbows close to your sides
Curl the bar up to shoulder height
Lower slowly back to starting position

name: Hammer Curls
instructions: Stand holding dumbbells with neutral grip (palms facing in)
Curl both dumbbells up simultaneously
Keep elbows stationary at your sides
Lower with control

name: Concentration Curl
instructions: Sit on a bench, elbow resting on inner thigh
Curl dumbbell up toward shoulder
Squeeze at the top
Lower slowly and repeat

name: Tricep Dips
instructions: Grip parallel bars and lift yourself up
Lower your body by bending elbows to 90 degrees
Keep torso upright to target triceps
Push back up to starting position

name: Skull Crushers
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest
Lower the bar toward your forehead by bending elbows
Keep upper arms stationary
Extend arms back to starting position

name: Cable Pushdown
instructions: Stand at a cable station with rope or bar attachment
Keep elbows close to your sides
Push the handle down until arms are fully extended
Slowly return to starting position

name: Barbell Squat
instructions: Place bar across upper back, feet shoulder-width apart
Brace core and descend by bending knees and hips
Go down until thighs are parallel or below
Drive through heels to stand back up

name: Leg Press
instructions: Sit on the leg press machine with feet shoulder-width on the platform
Release the safety and lower the platform toward you
Press through your heels to extend legs
Do not fully lock out your knees

name: Romanian Deadlift
instructions: Hold barbell at hip height with overhand grip
Push hips back while lowering the bar along your legs
Keep a slight bend in knees and back flat
Lower until you feel a hamstring stretch, then return

name: Walking Lunges
instructions: Stand tall with feet together
Step forward with one leg and lower until both knees are at 90 degrees
Push off the front foot and step forward with the other leg
Continue alternating legs

name: Leg Curl
instructions: Lie face down on the leg curl machine
Hook your ankles under the pad
Curl the weight up by bending your knees
Lower slowly back to starting position

name: Calf Raises
instructions: Stand on the edge of a step with heels hanging off
Rise up onto your toes as high as possible
Hold for a second at the top
Lower slowly below the step level for a full stretch

name: Plank
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position
Keep body in a straight line from head to heels
Engage your core and avoid sagging hips
Hold for the prescribed time

name: Hanging Leg Raises
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms extended
Raise your legs until they are parallel with the floor
Keep your legs straight and avoid swinging
Lower slowly back down

name: Russian Twist
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent, feet slightly elevated
Lean back slightly and clasp hands together
Rotate your torso to one side, then the other
Each side counts as one rep

name: Cable Woodchop
instructions: Set cable to high position, stand sideways
Grip handle with both hands
Pull diagonally across your body from high to low
Control the return, then switch sides

name: Hip Thrust
instructions: Sit with upper back against a bench, barbell over hips
Drive through heels to lift hips until body is in a straight line
Squeeze glutes at the top
Lower hips back down with control

name: Glute Bridge
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor
Drive through heels to lift your hips
Squeeze glutes at the top and hold briefly
Lower back down slowly

name: Bulgarian Split Squat
instructions: Stand with one foot on a bench behind you
Hold dumbbells at your sides
Lower until front thigh is parallel to the floor
Push through front heel to stand back up
